title: Completed ordinary pullback preserves goodness after extension
statement: For every open immersion j : X → Y and every good complex P on X, the completed ordinary pullback of its completed open extension is good on X.

proof.text: Apply openExtension_goodComplex_extension to P to obtain independent-coefficient K-flatness and site-flatness of every term of the completed open extension. Apply the already proved pro-etale specialization ringPull_preserves_flat of isKFlat_ringedToposPullback to j and the completed coefficient ring isomorphism. Its two conclusions are definitionally integralOperationsGoodComplex for integralOrdinaryPull of that extension.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0G7E, lemma-pullback-K-flat, using the existing pro-etale specialization after completed open extension.

from.place: Conjunct component of the preservation argument.

lean.statement:
theorem openExtension_goodComplex_pullback {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E X).FullSubcategory) :
    integralOperationsGoodComplex l E X
      (((integralOrdinaryPull l E j).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((PurCompactSupport.openExtension
        (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) j).mapHomologicalComplex
           (.up ℤ)).obj P.obj))
